[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided pros and cons for selling functional pieces: practical appeal, broad audience, competitive pricing, but also competition and quality control challenges.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided pros and cons for selling decorative pieces: unique appeal, less competition, artistic expression, but niche appeal and pricing challenges.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended starting with decorative pieces due to less pressure, the opportunity to develop style, and lower risk.
